presentation.name: Core symptoms
presentation.def: Cardinal features of the condition itself, in any system, including its characteristic pain

presentation.name: Time course
presentation.def: Onset, duration, pattern, progression, chronicity, diurnal or exacerbation pattern

presentation.name: Prodromal
presentation.def: Symptoms or warning signs before the main event (aura, prodrome)

presentation.name: Postdromal
presentation.def: Symptoms after the main event (postictal, post-attack recovery)

presentation.name: Constitutional
presentation.def: Fever, sweats, weight change, fatigue, appetite, malaise

presentation.name: Cardiovascular
presentation.def: Chest pain, palpitations, oedema, syncope, claudication, perfusion and rhythm symptoms

presentation.name: Respiratory
presentation.def: Breathlessness, cough, sputum, wheeze, haemoptysis, upper-airway symptoms

presentation.name: Gastrointestinal
presentation.def: Dysphagia, reflux, nausea, abdominal pain, bowel habit change, bleeding, jaundice

presentation.name: Genitourinary and reproductive
presentation.def: Urinary, sexual, menstrual, fertility and obstetric symptoms

presentation.name: Neurological
presentation.def: General neurological symptoms (headache, seizures, cognition, vertigo); use Motor, Sensory, Autonomic or Bulbar only for neurological conditions where the item fits one

presentation.name: Motor
presentation.def: Weakness, tremor, rigidity, gait and movement symptoms (neurological conditions)

presentation.name: Sensory
presentation.def: Numbness, paraesthesia, pain of neuropathic type (neurological conditions)

presentation.name: Autonomic
presentation.def: Orthostatic, bladder, bowel, sweating and sexual autonomic symptoms (neurological conditions)

presentation.name: Bulbar
presentation.def: Speech, swallowing, drooling and facial symptoms (neurological conditions)

presentation.name: Musculoskeletal
presentation.def: Joint, bone, muscle and back symptoms, stiffness, deformity

presentation.name: Skin and mucosa
presentation.def: Rash, ulcers, lumps, pruritus, mouth and mucosal symptoms

presentation.name: Eyes and vision
presentation.def: Visual loss, red eye, visual disturbance

presentation.name: Ear and hearing
presentation.def: Hearing loss, tinnitus, otalgia, vertigo of ear origin

presentation.name: Endocrine and metabolic
presentation.def: Heat/cold intolerance, thirst, polyuria, hormonal symptoms

presentation.name: Complications
presentation.def: Complications of the disease or its treatment that the patient may report

presentation.name: Red flags
presentation.def: Alarm features that need urgent escalation

presentation.name: Impact
presentation.def: Functional, work, emotional, psychosocial and quality-of-life effects

risks.name: Non-modifiable
risks.def: Age, sex, ethnicity, pregnancy, hormonal, anatomical and congenital predispositions

risks.name: Lifestyle
risks.def: Smoking, alcohol, diet, obesity, inactivity, substance use, behaviours

risks.name: Exposures
risks.def: Occupational, environmental, travel, allergen and contact exposures

risks.name: Infections
risks.def: Prior or concurrent infections as a cause or risk

risks.name: Drugs
risks.def: Medicines that cause or predispose (iatrogenic, nephrotoxins, steroids)

risks.name: Comorbidities
risks.def: Existing diseases that cause or predispose, including autoimmune, metabolic and past history

risks.name: Procedures and devices
risks.def: Surgery, lines, devices, dialysis access, instrumentation

risks.name: Triggers
risks.def: Precipitants of onset, attack or decompensation

examination.name: General and vitals
examination.def: Appearance, observations, nutrition, hydration, general inspection

examination.name: Head and neck
examination.def: Eyes, mouth, ENT, neck, thyroid, lymph nodes of the neck, JVP

examination.name: Cardiovascular
examination.def: Pulses, heart sounds, murmurs, BP, perfusion, vascular signs, oedema

examination.name: Respiratory
examination.def: Chest inspection, percussion, auscultation, breathing pattern, sputum

examination.name: Abdomen
examination.def: Abdominal inspection, palpation, organomegaly, ascites, hernias, rectal

examination.name: Neurological
examination.def: Cranial nerves, tone, power, reflexes, sensation, coordination, gait, cognition

examination.name: Musculoskeletal
examination.def: Joints, spine, muscles, deformity, range of motion

examination.name: Skin
examination.def: Skin, nails, hair, ulcers of skin, rash, bruising

examination.name: Local findings
examination.def: Findings at a specific site: ulcer, lump, stoma, access site, wound, prostate, genitalia

examination.name: Peripheral signs
examination.def: Signs outside the primary organ: stigmata, extra-articular, extra-intestinal, associated disease

examination.name: Special tests
examination.def: Named signs and manoeuvres and bedside severity tests

examination.name: Complications
examination.def: Signs of complications, metastases, spread or end-organ damage

investigations.name: Bedside
investigations.def: Point-of-care and clinic-based tests: obs, ECG, urinalysis, BSL, spirometry at the bedside, scores and questionnaires

investigations.name: Bloods
investigations.def: Any blood test, including markers, serology, drug levels, glycaemic control and clotting

investigations.name: Urine and stool
investigations.def: Urine and stool tests that are not culture: ACR, 24h urine, FOBT/FIT, calprotectin, stool studies

investigations.name: Microbiology
investigations.def: Cultures, swabs, PCR, tap fluid and other tests for infection

investigations.name: Imaging
investigations.def: X-ray, ultrasound, CT, MRI, nuclear, echo, angiography, DEXA

investigations.name: Functional
investigations.def: Physiological function tests: lung function, urodynamics, sleep studies, neurophysiology, audiometry, stress tests

investigations.name: Endoscopy
investigations.def: Scopes and direct visualisation: gastroscopy, colonoscopy, bronchoscopy, cystoscopy

investigations.name: Tissue and genetics
investigations.def: Biopsy, cytology, histology, molecular and genetic tests

investigations.name: Screening and risk
investigations.def: Screening programs, risk scores, pre-treatment and pre-intervention checks, diagnostic criteria

investigations.name: Monitoring and staging
investigations.def: Staging work-up, ongoing disease monitoring and drug-level or complication surveillance

medications.name: Acute
medications.def: Emergency and acute-phase treatment (thrombolysis, resuscitation, exacerbation, rescue)

medications.name: Escalation
medications.def: Add-on, second-line, resistant-disease and advanced therapies

medications.name: Disease-modifying
medications.def: Treatments that change disease course: DMARDs, immunotherapy, antivirals, anti-cancer, curative

medications.name: Symptomatic
medications.def: Symptom relief and supportive drugs: analgesia, antiemetics, bronchodilator relievers

medications.name: Procedural
medications.def: Surgery, drainage, revascularisation, devices, transplantation, other interventions

medications.name: Non-drug
medications.def: Lifestyle, diet, rehab, physiotherapy, allied health, self-management, education

medications.name: Prevention
medications.def: Primary and secondary prevention, prophylaxis, vaccination, risk-factor control

medications.name: Palliative
medications.def: Palliative and end-of-life care, advance planning

medications.name: Monitoring
medications.def: Follow-up, drug monitoring, safety checks, surveillance

differentials.name: Cardiovascular
differentials.def: Heart and rhythm causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Respiratory
differentials.def: Lung and airway causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Gastrointestinal
differentials.def: Oesophageal, gastric, bowel and anorectal causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Hepatobiliary and pancreatic
differentials.def: Liver, biliary, gallbladder and pancreatic causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Renal and urological
differentials.def: Kidney, bladder, prostate and genital causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Gynaecological and obstetric
differentials.def: Gynaecological, breast and obstetric causes

differentials.name: Neurological
differentials.def: Central and peripheral nervous system causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Musculoskeletal
differentials.def: Bone, joint, muscle and soft-tissue causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Skin
differentials.def: Dermatological causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Eye
differentials.def: Ocular causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Ear, nose and throat
differentials.def: ENT causes that don't fit a mechanism category

differentials.name: Haematological
differentials.def: Blood, coagulation and platelet disorders, anaemias

differentials.name: Endocrine and metabolic
differentials.def: Endocrine, metabolic, nutritional and electrolyte causes

differentials.name: Infective
differentials.def: Infections of any organ, when the item is clearly an infection

differentials.name: Inflammatory and autoimmune
differentials.def: Inflammatory and autoimmune causes, when clearly so

differentials.name: Malignant
differentials.def: Cancers and neoplasms of any organ, when clearly so

differentials.name: Vascular
differentials.def: Ischaemic, thrombotic, embolic and haemorrhagic vascular causes in any organ

differentials.name: Structural and traumatic
differentials.def: Mechanical, anatomical, obstructive, congenital and traumatic causes

differentials.name: Drugs and toxins
differentials.def: Medicines, alcohol, substances, poisons and withdrawal

differentials.name: Psychiatric and behavioural
differentials.def: Mental health and behavioural causes

differentials.name: Physiological and functional
differentials.def: Normal physiology, variants and functional disorders

associated.name: Characteristics
associated.def: Nature, severity, location, distribution, quality and pattern of the main symptom

associated.name: Onset and course
associated.def: Onset, duration, progression, timing, frequency, pattern over time

associated.name: Event and collateral
associated.def: Details of a discrete event and witness or collateral history

associated.name: Gastrointestinal

associated.name: Genitourinary and reproductive

associated.name: Musculoskeletal and skin

associated.name: Eye, ear, nose and throat
associated.def: Eye, ear, nose and throat symptoms

associated.name: Psychological
associated.def: Mood, anxiety, cognition, psychosis, sleep and psychiatric history

associated.name: Red flags

associated.name: Past history
associated.def: Relevant past medical and surgical history, previous episodes, screening

associated.name: Drugs and substances
associated.def: Medications, alcohol, tobacco and recreational substances

associated.name: Exposures and contacts
associated.def: Travel, occupational, environmental, infective contacts, allergens

associated.name: Risk factors
associated.def: Demographic, lifestyle and family risk factors

associated.name: Social and function
associated.def: Social circumstances, function, independence, impact on life
